results.summary_before: This project implements a hardware-optimized Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) neuron in Verilog, designed for area efficiency while maintaining biological realism. It includes a serial interface for loading parameters and provides outputs for membrane voltage and spike events. The design can be used with DIP switches for stimulus and LEDs or a 7-segment display for monitoring. No external hardware is required for basic operation.

results.summary_before: This project implements current-switching DACs for generating analog VGA signals, using a 16x16 matrix of unit current sources to convert 8-bit digital inputs to analog current outputs. It is intended for analog VGA displays and requires external pull-up resistors and opamps to convert the current to voltage. The digital display controller is not yet implemented, and testing details are incomplete. The design is an experiment in analog VGA signal generation.

results.summary_before: LEDs Racer is a multiplayer game where up to four players press arcade buttons to race their LED segment toward a center circle on a WS2812B LED ring. The design drives the LED data line and provides per-player ready-to-play indicators and a frame update signal. It requires external arcade buttons with pull-down resistors and a WS2812B LED ring. The documentation is brief but sufficient to understand the game and its hardware needs.
